body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by an opposed Action or Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose the Endurance Attribute of the targeted Defense: Vigor for Fortitude, Resolve for Composure, or Anima for Harmony. Roll at least 2 Reaction dice, up to that Attribute; if the Attribute is 1, your maximum is 2 instead. This Reaction is unopposed. Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the triggering card.

surges.html: Increase that Defense by an additional +1 against the triggering card.
